title: A quota/rate-limit failure sets cooldown (capacity is deprioritized, not silently retried)
notes: GREEN: the worker emits a quota line and fails; operatord flow-control sets runtime_state='cooldown' (matches test_operatord_daemon.py::test_failed_quota_task_sets_cooldown). RED: fault makes the worker succeed within quota -> 'completed', operator idle -> cooldown assertion fails.
